title: Leukocyte adhesion deficiency type 1 (LAD-1)/variant. A novel immunodeficiency syndrome characterized by dysfunctional beta2 integrins.
evidence_quote: A structural defect (deletion or point mutation) in the 𝛃2 subunit (with special attention to the transmembrane and cytoplasmic tail) was excluded by sequencing CD18 cDNA, indicating that this patient did not suffer from classical LAD-1.
helper_note: LAD-1/variant with normal CD11/CD18 expression and no CD18 defect on sequencing; not classical LAD-I.

title: APOC3 and ABCA1 variants in unusual combined hypolipidaemia showing premature peripheral vascular disease.
evidence_quote: This variant is shared by all three family members PID1-PID3, conÞ rming its segregation in the family, and being in line with dominant inheritance of primary hypoalphalipoproteinemia.
helper_note: Three heterozygous ABCA1 carriers (ABCA1 +/wt) with combined hypolipidaemia/hypoalphalipoproteinaemia; no one presented as having Tangier disease.

title: Characterization of apolipoprotein A-I- and A-II-containing lipoproteins in a new case of high density lipoprotein deficiency resembling Tangier disease and their effects on intracellular cholesterol efflux.
evidence_quote: Since the molecular defects underlying the profound HDL deficiency in IM and in Tangier disease are not known, a definitive statement regarding whether IM has Tangier disease cannot be made.
helper_note: Close call: one patient with Tangier-like HDL deficiency and features, but the authors do not diagnose Tangier disease and no gene was studied.

title: [Case of familial hypoalphalipoproteinemia, type 2 diabetes mellitus and markedly advanced atherosclerosis with ABCAlexon 4 minus transcript in macrophages].
evidence_quote: 62歲の男性．角膜輪，冠動脈硬化症，鎖骨下動脈硬化症，腹部·下肢閉塞性動脈硬 化症を呈した家族性低HDL血症と糖尿病を合併した症例を経験した.
helper_note: Japanese text; the single patient has familial low HDL (HDL-C 28 mg/dl) with an ABCA1 exon 4-skipping transcript, not Tangier disease.

title: [Tangier disease in family with the phenotype of familial hypercholesterolemia].
evidence_quote: V naší práci popisujeme prvního pacienta s homozygotní formou Tangierské nemoci v České republice.
helper_note: Main text in Czech (English abstract only); describes one compound heterozygous ABCA1 patient.

title: TNF receptor signalling in autoinflammatory diseases.
evidence_quote: In this review we discuss autoinflammatory diseases which arise from mutations in genes encoding components of the TNF signalling pathway.
helper_note: Narrative review of TNFR signalling diseases; HA20 cases (including one AOSD patient with a TNFAIP3 variant) are cited only in passing, with no per-patient table.
